observations: A rounded head-like form fills the center, built from overlapping white circular lines on a warm tan-gold ground, with two glowing cream-white ovals where eyes might be, emitting a horizontal light streak to the right.
Three thick gold vertical bars occupy the upper-right corner against a flat orange rectangle, while a broad dark-red horizontal bar cuts across the lower third of the composition.
On the left side, dense magenta and dark marks cluster around a small square shape, contrasting with looser pink, red, and white scribbled lines layered across the whole surface.
reading: Two blazing cream ovals anchor the center and push light outward in a flat horizontal beam, giving the layered head-form a blinded or broadcasting quality. The warm ground is interrupted by hard geometry—orange block, gold bars, red stripe—that reads as pressure against the softer circular scrawl. The magenta cluster on the left pulls attention away from the glow, leaving the composition unresolved rather than settled.
